Subject: Clarification on the Expense Report Submission Process

Dear Team,

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to clarify our routine process for submitting expense reports. Please ensure that all expenses are claimed within 30 days of incurring them. Expenses not reported within this timeframe may not be reimbursable. Receipts and detailed descriptions must be included with your submission; failure to do so may delay the reimbursement process.

If you have any questions or require further assistance, please do not hesitate to reach out to me. Your prompt attention to this procedure will ensure timely reimbursement and help maintain our financial operations.

Thank you for your
